abstract: Planning is a common yet complex activity shaped by constraints to satisfy and preferences to balance. Travel planning, as both an everyday activity and a frequent benchmark for evaluating intelligent systems, offers a rich context for examining how constraints and preferences emerge and evolve. While recent AI systems have achieved impressive results in generating personalized itineraries, they often assume that users can articulate stable goals upfront. To understand how real-world planning unfolds, we conducted a two-part interview study: one with eight travelers reflecting on their planning experiences, and one with nine travel agents sharing professional practices. We trace the dynamics of constraints and preferences as they are surfaced, refined, and coordinated throughout the planning process, and identified 11 actions revolving around constraints and preferences, which shaped the planning process. We offer design heuristics for planning tools that better support human-AI collaborative actions to support the fluid, contingent nature of planning.

ob.tldr: 研究问题：当前AI旅行规划系统假设用户能预先表达稳定目标，忽视真实规划中约束与偏好的动态变化。方法：对8位旅行者和9位旅行顾问开展两部分访谈，追踪规划过程中约束与偏好的浮现、调整与协调过程。核心发现：归纳出11种围绕约束与偏好的规划行动；据此提出面向人机协作规划工具的设计启发式，以支持规划的流动性与情境性。

title: How Constraints and Preferences Shape Travel Planning: Implications for AI Planning Support
title_zh: 约束与偏好如何塑造旅行规划：对人工智能规划支持的启示
